measurement_limits: MongoDB sizes are BSON before connection compression.
Received bytes are separate from bytes sent; do not add incoming reads to outbound billing.
TLS, connection overhead and other Render resources are not included.
Function names, collection names and API consumer numeric IDs only; no request values or credentials.
uncertainties: Per-recipient errors are not present; cannot label every failure as a blocked user.
Aggregate /api/products error count has no HTTP status breakdown in the supplied report.
Broadcast volume alone does not prove duplicate events or an infinite loop.
Traffic and BSON estimates are process-local; synthetic benchmark savings are not a billing forecast.
